question: $3x^2+3y^2+9x-12y+18=0$ বৃত্তটির কেন্দ্র-
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ$3\mathrm x^2+3\mathrm y^2+9\mathrm x-12\mathrm y+18=0\\\Rightarrow\mathrm x^2+\mathrm y^2+3\mathrm x-4\mathrm y+6=0\\\Rightarrow\mathrm x^2+\mathrm y^2+3\mathrm x-4\mathrm y+6=0\\\Rightarrow\mathrm x^2+\mathrm y^2+2(\frac32)\mathrm x+2(-2)\mathrm y+6=0\\\mathrm{বৃত্তের}\;\mathrm{কেন্দ্র}=(-\mathrm g,-\mathrm f)=(\frac{-3}2,2)$
